comments.body: For triage: #22366 fixes #22358 too, opened 90 seconds before this one, and its `cmd/k8s-nameserver/main.go` change to the A branch is identical line for line. The two differ only elsewhere: #22366 also updates the `handleFunc` doc comment to describe the new A behaviour, which this PR leaves saying "NXDOMAIN if the name doesn't exist"; this PR's test case also sets `RecursionDesired`. The change itself mirrors the AAAA branch and looks right to me, so either one would do.
